sources: https://potawatomiecampground.com/forms (2024 Price List PDF and 2023 map)

hookups.source: https://potawatomiecampground.com/weekend-rates (nightly site types 'Partial Sewer' and 'Sewer, Water & Electric'; monthly rate 'Includes lawn care & electric'), read 2026-10-22. Amperage not stated.

values.note: 180 campsites, seasonal and transient. The seasonal contract says 40 ft 'is the maximum length for any lot; some lots require shorter campers.'

sites.source: https://potawatomiecampground.com/ ('We have 180 campsites, both seasonal and transient') + https://potawatomiecampground.com/seasonal-rules (rule 19: 'New campers shall be no longer than 40’ in length. This is the maximum length for any lot; some lots require shorter campers'), read 2026-10-22. The stored 60 ft came from note prose and is contradicted.

season.source: https://potawatomiecampground.com/ ('Our season begins April 15 and ends October 15'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Camp store with groceries, ice, firewood, bait and hand-dipped ice cream; boat, kayak, canoe and paddleboard rentals; fish-cleaning table.

facilities.source: https://potawatomiecampground.com/ ('laundry facilities', 'We also have a camp store offering boat rentals, candy, pop, water, ... groceries, ice, firewood, live bait, camping supplies') + seasonal-rules (rule 16, fish cleaning table), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No online booking: the site gives a phone number (517-278-4289) and e-mail. Sites are paid in full when booked; full refund with 1 week's notice (2 weeks for holidays: Memorial Day weekend, Fourth of July week, Labor Day weekend, Halloweekend). Weekly stays get the 7th night free.

booking.source: https://potawatomiecampground.com/weekend-rates ('Sites are to be paid in full at the time of booking'; cancellation policy) + home page (phone), read 2026-10-22

note: Family-owned for 50+ years, on Fox Lake, one of three connected lakes limited to trolling motors, near Union City; large sandy beach, swim raft, fishing dock, nature trail along Hog Creek. Seasonal and transient sites. --Claude
summary: Operator site live and Google Maps open ('Potawatomie Recreation Area', 4.4 stars / 166 reviews, phone 517-278-4289). Confirmed 180 sites, season Apr 15 - Oct 15, water/sewer sites, laundry and store. Changed max_rig_ft 60 -> 40 (the seasonal contract's 'maximum length for any lot'). Added phone booking. Fees left as recorded ($50 partial sewer / $55 full, holidays $60/$65, from the nightly-rates page, which is undated). Note: dropped season, site count, the wrong 60 ft and 'rustic' (no rustic sites are listed). Nearest gateway none within 40 km; the family has not stayed here.
flags: Missing phone: the operator's number is (517) 278-4289 (site and Google listing). Name: the operator spells it 'Potawatomie Campground & Recreational Area, Inc.' (Google: 'Potawatomie Recreation Area'); the entry has 'Potawatomi Campground & Recreation Area'.

Rate not dated: the nightly table (Partial Sewer $50, Sewer/Water/Electric $55; holidays $60/$65) is on an undated page of a site last dated 2024 (copyright 2023, '2024 Price List', '2024 Seasonal Contract'); no 2025/2026 rates are posted. Base $50 sits exactly at the US$50 line; no gateway within 40 km (Grand Rapids 115 km).

Long-stay character: the park is 'both seasonal and transient' with a seasonal contract (decks, sheds, camper sales on lots, April 15 - October 15); the seasonal share is not published (the map labels lots only). It posts nightly and weekly rates, so test 2 passes; test 4 (1 site in 10 nightly) cannot be checked from the pages.

Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator says 'We are located on Fox Lake' with a 'large sandy beach' and fishing dock; the entry is 'not waterfront' (the campground's beach, not necessarily the RV sites).
